title: Depth Clock
description: Tall conifers from straight below, their trunks rising from every edge to a cobalt zenith, and the time set very large across the open well of air between them and one towering cumulus. The figures stand low in the well, between the cloud and the crowns: the 1 and the 4 reach into the left and right crowns, whose branches and needles cut across them because the figures really sit behind the trees, while the colon and the 0s stand on the body of the cloud, its sunlit crown rising clear above them: the photo is taken back to scene light, split by its depth into trees and a plane for the time, the matte cut down to single needles, a cumulus congestus from a second capture is set behind them in a sky drawn from their own cobalt, and every plane moves by its own parallax as you tilt. The figures are pale and sky-lit, never white, and bleed a little light into the air as a diffusion filter would, while the cumulus at infinity is drawn as crisply as the needles in front of it; the trees are graded as a scan would render them, their phone-lime greens pulled toward olive-teal, their crushed crowns lifted onto a cyan toe, the sky bled a few pixels into every needle as through a Pro-Mist and a thin warm halation where the bright cloud meets a dark branch, and the whole frame is developed like daylight negative film with moving grain. The minutes tick over with a small roll.
intent: After the iOS 16 Lock Screen depth effect, where the clock sits between the wallpaper's background and its subject (https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2022/06/apple-reimagines-the-iphone-experience-with-ios-16/), translated into reality in the computer: a real capture split into planes, with the time physically in the air between them.

sources.author: Troy Olson (@city2forest)
sources.note: The conifers, Farragut State Park, Idaho: a phone ultra-wide pointed straight up (4000 x 3000). Taken back to scene-linear light with the edit's vignette partly lifted and its contrast eased, and modelled as a rectilinear camera of about 108 degrees centred on the trunks' vanishing point (plate.py); depth by Depth Anything V2 Small (tools/depth/depth_hr.py); matte by unmixing each pixel between the local sky, found by colour and depth in the gaps between needles, and the local foreground colour (bake.py).

sources.author: Greg Zaal
sources.note: The cumulus. Delta 2 at 16k: a midday park whose sky holds one cumulus congestus standing about fifty degrees from its base to its crown. Reprojected through the conifers' own camera by a rotation that sets the tower's middle (azimuth -40, elevation 42 in the capture) under the figures at (1900, 1400) with the capture's up kept as the frame's up, so it keeps its true size and its crown rises clear above the figures. Only that one mass is kept (found by chroma against the local clear sky, the capture's trees and ground refused, its upper deck and the small cumulus off its flank gated out along its own billows), and of it only the largest connected body, feathered, so no wisp or scrap floats free of the tower; the patch of its flank crossed by the capture's own branches is closed and filled from the cloud around it; the clear sky around it is drawn new from the conifers' cobalt, pale beside the cloud, a little paler toward the low sun, and deepening by over a stop toward the top of the frame. Nothing of the capture's own clear sky is kept, not even as texture (it carried the park's trees as a ghost crown over the figures); the air's slight unevenness is drawn. The cloud's broad light is lifted toward its crown so the mass glows while its billows keep their form, lit warm on its sunlit crown with half that warmth through its whole body and pale skylight blue in its bellies, its body under the crown lifted up to 1.3 stops along a monotone curve of its broad light so the tower reads as one luminous mass well over the blue and no lifted billow passes the crown, crisped in light only, and held under a soft shoulder so nothing clips (bake_clouds.py, PX=1900 PY=1400 TOP=0.72 GAM=0.72 DETAIL=1.6 SHADE=0.35 SKYLIGHT=0.35 WARM=0.5 DARK=0.03 LIFT=1.3 LITBLUR=14 KEEP=0.04 FEATHER=2.5 AIR=0.03 DEEP=1.3 LIMIT=0.92).
